description: Smoke test of the 3 MCP tools, called through the vibe coder (Claude Code) connected to the campus-customs server defined in .mcp.json. Values were then checked against data/campus_customs_new.db with sqlite3.
server: campus-customs (./.venv/bin/python mcp_server/server.py, stdio; the file was named mcp_server.py when this smoke test was run and was renamed server.py in Problem 11 to match the required layout)

tests.prompt: Use the campus-customs MCP tool check_stock to look up SKU CC-TEE-WHITE in size S (ticket 101).
tests.matches_database: inventory: CC-TEE-WHITE/S qty 0, Aisle B; pricing: unit_cost 8.0, list_price 28.0

tests.prompt: Use the campus-customs MCP tool get_invoice_status to look up invoice 501 (linked from ticket 101).
tests.matches_database: invoices: 501, vendor 1, 840.0, due 2026-08-28, open; vendors: Bulldog Print Co, lead_days 5; desk.date_today 2026-08-31 (3 days overdue)

tests.prompt: Use the campus-customs MCP tool get_lease_status to look up lease 1 (ticket 102).
tests.matches_database: leases: id 1, 2400.0, next_due 2026-09-02; desk.date_today 2026-08-31 (2 days until due)
